mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a pleasant 76 degrees at Verona Community Park under a new moon. We expect the temperature to dip to a low of 68 degrees overnight, and there is no rain in the forecast.

City Hall reminds residents that construction on Highway M starts August 18th, impacting traffic between Highway PB and M, and please note that the Plan Commission will meet on September 8th to review several development projects.

Today is packed with activities, including yoga at Insight Wellness, the downtown farmers market, and pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, catch the free concert at Century School Park or join the fun at Hop Haus trivia.
Looking at the weekly report, on August 5th, officers arrested a 37-year-old man on Whalen Road for a probation violation after he attempted to flee custody.
Indulge in today's flavor, Chocolate Covered Strawberry. We are open until 10 PM, so there is still plenty of time to stop by and enjoy a scoop before we close for the night.
